item.title: Incarico di ricerca: Multilingual Bites (MuBi): How migration and minority languages shape Italy's culinary vocabulary (ROMA "La Sapienza")
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-07 23:59
Institution: ROMA "La Sapienza", Roma
Field: Classics, philology, literature, art history / 10/ANGL-01 Anglistica e angloamericanistica

The person hired for this research position will collaborate on the core activities of the MuBi project, contributing to the collection, organization, and analysis of linguistic data regarding culinary microlanguage in multicultural contexts. They will participate in conducting ethnographic interviews in home kitchens, restaurants, markets, and reception centers, handling the preparation of protocols, contact management, and the collection of informed consent. They will use ASR tools for multilingual transcription, verifying and correcting the transcripts. item.title: Incarico di ricerca: Popular Writings of the Great War: Letters of Romanian and Italian Soldiers in the Regional Archives of Cluj-Napoca (1914-1918) (Univ. PADOVA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-20 13:00
Institution: Univ. PADOVA, Padova
Field: Classics, philology, literature, art history / 10/FLMR-01 Filologie e letterature medio-latina e romanze

The research project carries out the first mapping and comparative analysis of the "World War I Letters" collection at the Regional Archives of Cluj-Napoca, Romania (SJAN – Cluj). This little-known collection contains 557 files with letters, postcards, and war diaries (1914–1918) by Austro-Hungarian soldiers and their families. The study focuses on two main groups: Romanian common soldiers, who mostly wrote in verse following traditional oral poetry styles, and Italian soldiers from the Habsburg borderlands (Trentino, Veneto, Friuli, Venezia Giulia, Dalmatia) serving in the same army and often on the same fronts. item.title: Incarico di ricerca: A Working-Class Hero Is Something to Be Decolonized: The Representation of the Working Class in 21st-Century Spanish-American Fiction (Univ. PADOVA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-20 13:00
Institution: Univ. PADOVA, Padova
Field: Classics, philology, literature, art history / 10/SPAN-01 Lingue, letterature e culture spagnola e ispano-americane

This research analyzes the representation of the working class in 21st-century Hispanic American narrative. From a decolonial perspective, it examines the applicability of the category of working-class literature to a context where labor intersects with coloniality, racialization, gender, extractivism, and territorial inequalities. item.title: Incarico di ricerca: Italian–Spanish Bilingual Onomasiological Lexicography from the Seventeenth to the Nineteenth Century: Tradition and Digital Representation (Univ. PADOVA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-20 13:00
Institution: Univ. PADOVA, Padova
Field: Classics, philology, literature, art history / 10/SPAN-01 Lingue, letterature e culture spagnola e ispano-americane

The project investigates three Italian-Spanish bilingual thesauri published between 1626 and 1898, examining them both as tools for language learning and as historical records of how everyday knowledge was organised. Using a pilot corpus of approximately 12,000 headwords (Franciosini, Chirchmair and Foulques), the research will analyse core-vocabulary selection, thematic and conceptual structures,paratexts, and contexts of production and circulation. Its methodological aim is to develop a digital model that preserves the onomasiological specificity of these works by integrating TEI Lex-0 encoding, OntoLex-Lemon/SKOS semantic modelling, and network analysis. item.title: Incarico di ricerca: Urban Memory and Active Citizenship: a model for the enhancement of Palermo's post-war sites through scientific comparison with the Chongqing case study (Univ. PALERMO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-30 12:00
Institution: Univ. PALERMO, Palermo
Field: Classics, philology, literature, art history / 10/ASIA-01 Culture e lingue dell'asia centrale, meridionale, orientale e sud-orientale

This research proposal stems from a critical observation conducted in the urban context of Palermo: the presence of numerous ruins and sites marked by the 1943 bombings is today perceived in a distorted way by the local community and by visitors. During an observation experience at the University Language Centre (CLA), it emerged that even long-term foreign residents interpret the architectural "wounds" of the historic center as signs of mere building neglect, ignoring their wartime origin. This phenomenon of historical amnesia also profoundly affects the new generations of citizens of Palermo, for whom the disconnection between physical space and the memory of the events that shaped it is…

item.title: Incarico di ricerca: Narrating Natural-Cultural Heritage: Towards a Literary Mapping of the Global South, Starting from Sicily (Univ. PALERMO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-30 12:00
Institution: Univ. PALERMO, Palermo
Field: Classics, philology, literature, art history / 10/COMP-01 Comparatistica e teoria della letteratura

This research project focuses on the apparent opacity of landscapes in relation to narrative. This resistance seems to be due, on the one hand, to the lack of attention that human history has always paid to the environment, and on the other, to the gaps in the available narrative forms, which are mostly oriented towards the human scale and the immediatepresent. Consequently, these have not been sufficient to capture the complexity of places where geological, ecological and historical time are layered without ever resulting in a linear narrative

item.title: Incarico di ricerca: Unveiling Agricultural and Breeding Practices in Italian Protohistory (PROTO-GREEN (ROMA "Tor Vergata")
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-18 23:59
Institution: ROMA "Tor Vergata", Roma, Rm
Field: Classics, philology, literature, art history / 10/ARCH-01 Archeologia

The position involves carrying out stable carbon and nitrogen isotope analyses (δ13C, δ15N) on archaeobotanical and faunal remains, and stable oxygen isotope analyses (δ18O) on the dental enamel of faunal remains, within the framework of the PROTO-GREEN project, in collaboration with the University of Parma. The researcher will be responsible for sample preparation and data acquisition, while also contributing to their interpretation. The position further includes support for bibliographic research and for the digitisation of the data acquired over the course of the project, as well as support for the organisation of the project's outreach activities.
